items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: I traveled with Leslie Uggams and I traveled with the King family, they always used to carry — and Jerry McKenzie was a drummer with the Kings, they’d carry a lead trumpet player and a drummer and a conductor/piano.

ctx.x: It seems like a hard thing to define, like does it have a lot to do with the drummer — where he plays his fills and setting up the downbeat? And you two have to be like in sync.

He’s got to set — he has to set you up and to get that excitement going, you know the intensity. You know because you know I traveled, well I traveled with Leslie Uggams and I traveled with the King family, they always used to carry — and Jerry McKenzie was a drummer with the Kings, they’d carry a lead trumpet player and a drummer and a conductor/piano. That’s the main thing. Period. And you had, that’s what most acts carried. That was good — guys like would travel with Robert Goulet as his first trumpet player…
Did you have it in the back of your mind that someday you might direct the Harry James Orchestra?
